title: ר' יודן בר חנין
author: Heilprin source tradition; Warsaw digital witness

paragraphs: R. Yudan bar Chanin: one who eats from his fellow is ashamed to look at him—Orlah, chapter 1, halakhah 4. Jerusalem Kiddushin, chapter 2, halakhah 6, has bar Chanan in Heilprin’s report. [The checked text at 2:5:2 reads Yudan beRabbi Chanan.] In R. Berekhiah's name: Chelek, halakhah 2.
